* A right-to-left paragraph starts at its right edge by default, in text, table cells and Markdown (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3k9)

justify gains "start", the paragraph's own edge; Column and Markdown default
to it, and an unjustified right-to-left row is placed right. plain keeps its
bytes: logical order's start is the line's first character.
